skins.name: Hear the Wind Sing
skins.description: New concept based on the theme of Wind, a collaborative work between multiple designers. The ever-present floating ribbons capture the shape of the wind.

skins.name: Sweet Jackpot
skins.description: You can't win the sweets competition by wearing a uniform! Insider put this on before diving head-first into the bakery, and he's about to present his creation. Don't worry, the sweetness has been adjusted to suit your tastes.

skins.name: There They Be
skins.description: Saga's attire when she left P'o-shan Village , with Biteys for pockets and straw sandals. What is in the scrolls cannot be removed, but after so much time spent with oneselves, what was drawn in ink is now etched in the heart.

skins.name: The Fruition
skins.description: Classic black and white, with just a touch of color. No need for complex ornamentations; any flair belongs to the performer alone.

skins.name: The Road to Here
skins.description: Loose-fitting coat that can envelop a young girl. The waterproof fabric makes it suitable for a rainy day.
